policies.title: Abolish Indefinite Leave to Remain
policies.statement: Replace Indefinite Leave to Remain with five-year renewable work visas requiring higher salary thresholds, mandatory English fluency, and stricter character requirements, with no access to benefits for foreign nationals.

policies.title: Scrap Net Zero Targets
policies.statement: Abandon all net-zero climate commitments, related subsidies, and associated government programmes to redirect funding to other priorities.

policies.title: Increase Police Numbers
policies.statement: Recruit 40,000 additional police officers over a parliament, expand stop-and-search powers, and introduce mandatory minimum sentences including automatic life terms for certain violent offenders.

policies.title: NHS Staffing Expansion
policies.statement: Fund 20,000 additional doctors and 40,000 additional nurses by cutting NHS management costs and abolishing NHS England as an organization.

policies.title: Raise Income Tax Threshold
policies.statement: Increase the income tax personal allowance to £20,000 to reduce the tax burden on lower and middle earners.

policies.title: Tax Relief on Private Healthcare
policies.statement: Introduce a 20% tax relief on private healthcare and dental treatment to encourage use of private services and reduce demand on the NHS.
